# The reusable workflows' jobs that need a private runner: one "<workflow file> <job>" per line. A job listed here
# reaches what only our own runners reach (a private host or network, the cluster or one of its secrets, a device), so
# its runs-on names the ARC scale set (arc-freemixer) itself and never reads vars.OMX_RUNNER: the organisation
# variable moves to a hosted label and a job that still read it would leave the pool it needs. Every other job of a
# reusable runs on a GitHub-hosted runner unless its caller passes a runner. The audit of 2026-11-16 found none.
